items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results, and operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this is not complete TLS evidence. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, continue bounded read-only evidence work, and permit ordinary reversible growth only when existing consent, disclosures, data-handling, and claims boundaries remain unchanged. Do not access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
